Defense-Grade Engineering

ModularStep is a premier brand by Teknosis, delivering certified, high-reliability modular aluminum access systems designed and fabricated under strict military and civil safety standards.

Manufacturing Excellence in Ankara

620m² Consolidated Production & R&D Center

Our climbing and access systems are fabricated locally at our 620-square-meter consolidated R&D and manufacturing facility located in the Saray industrial district of Kahramankazan, Ankara. By uniting our engineering, welding, testing, and shipping divisions under one roof, we eliminate logistics friction and ensure 100% production trace safety.

Utilizing structural aluminum alloys (6061-T6, 6082-T6) and precision automated welding processes, we manufacture climbing platforms, mobile scaffolding, and aviation dock stands that stand up to the most demanding industrial requirements.

100% TÜV SÜD Cert Compliance

Quality Management Policy

We operate under a strict ISO 9001 quality management framework. Every weld, connection component, and step tread profile undergoes inspection and loading tests. All structures are modeled and verified using finite element analysis (FEA) before tooling, ensuring compliance with both European EN and American OSHA access specifications.

HSE (Health & Safety) Commitment

At Teknosis, workplace safety is non-negotiable. Our climbing systems are engineered defensively to eliminate the risk of falls, slippage, or structural instability. By manufacturing pre-engineered, bolt-together climbing platforms, we reduce the hazards of field-welding and high-altitude assembly on our clients' job sites.
